name: Vigilante Savant
body:
You gain a masked talent.

Prerequisite(s): Vigilante level 7th.

Benefit(s): You gain a vigilante talent, treating your vigilante level as half when determining for which vigilante talents you can select with this feat.

Special: You cannot select this feat if you possess the Vigilante Casting Savant feat.
